correctness.rationale: Tree edge gradients are independent coordinates modulo constants. On every gradient-box face, the largest signed outward derivative is exactly r^(p−1)(A_e−D_e), obtained by independently assigning signs/magnitudes to adjacent gradients. Invariance of all gradient boxes proves iff condition and instantaneous derivative. x_e=c_eℓ_e^(p−1) converts the inequalities to Bx≤x; irreducible Perron–Frobenius establishes ρ(B)≤1, with critical positive gauge unique up to scale. For p≠2 and adjacent edges, the Jacobian off-diagonal response |g_f|^(p−2) can overwhelm fixed diagonal loss by varying g_f; an explicit 3-vertex path witness makes two-input distance increase. Independent p=1.2,1.5,2.5,3,4 path Jacobians and a 3-leaf star PF threshold corroborate, not prove, the theorem.
